verdict.rationale: Raygun exposes an external access token and APIs (Deployments API, source map/dSYM/ProGuard uploads) that are typically invoked from CI build scripts, implying some headless/automation usage, but there is no explicit CI/CD pipeline documentation, CLI tool, or dedicated 'headless mode' described. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs, official CLI for automation, examples of running the product headlessly outside of token-based API calls.
